ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
CHA-3.G.1
Methods for calculating derivatives of real-
valued functions can be extended to parametric
functions. bc only
CHA-3.G.2
For a curve defined parametrically, the value
of
dy
dx
at a point on the curve is the slope of
the line tangent to the curve at that point.
dy
dx
,
the slope of the line tangent to a curve defined
using parametric equations, can be determined
by dividing
dy
dt
by
dx
dt
, provided
dx
dt
does not
equal zero. bc only
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
CHA-3
Derivatives allow us to solve real-world problems involving rates of change.
